subject: Lumina — contract redlines and timing for pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Nair <asha@luminahealth.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 15:00:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Lumina pilot

Hi Asha / Sam —

Great to meet this morning. Quick recap and the next steps we agreed on for the pilot: 

- Goal: evaluate Redwood inference for in-product summarization (50k monthly active users, ~1.2M tokens/month).
- Success metrics: 95% uptime, 200ms median p95 latency, quality threshold: human eval > 0.85 on our prompt set.
- Pilot scope: 2-week sandbox → 6-week pilot with 1 dedicated model variant and SLO targets.
- Data/Compliance: we discussed VPC private deployment and audit logging options.

Action items:
- Marissa (me): share discovery notes and sample config + high-level pricing estimate (attached).
- Asha / Sam: confirm stakeholders for procurement + legal contacts and preferred timeline for pilot sign-off.
- Jonas: will coordinate engineering kickoff once procurement is aligned.

Attachments: discovery-notes-lumina-20260217.pdf (high-level notes + config)

Proposed next step: 15–20 min check on week of Feb 23 to confirm procurement timeline. Are you available?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Hi —

Per our discussion, attached are Redwood's proposed redlines to the pilot agreement (PDF attached). Key notes:
- These redlines are intended to tighten up data controls and clarify rollback/fallback policies for the pilot.
- We flagged two areas for counsel: indemnity language and data retention clauses.
- Requested response timeframe: 7 business days if possible so we can lock the pilot schedule for March.

Attachment: Lumina_Redlines_v1.pdf

If you prefer to have our counsel and your counsel talk directly, happy to set that up — Jonas (cc) can join on the legal sync.

Thanks,
